notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.content:
The Bad Mechanic Demo has received a big fat update for Steam Next Fest! The number of towers has more than doubled, status effects like poison and stun have been added, and the game has become much more challenging and strategical!

Here are some towers you can expect in the new demo:
[list]
[*] Sushi Truck - Poisons enemies with questionable sushi
[*] Tower Factory - Spawns moving towers that shoot enemies
[*] Bumper - Reflects bullets that come into contact
[*] Money Printer - Prints money at the end of each round
[*] Freeze Ray - Freezes multiple enemies at once with laser blasts
[/list]
...and more!

play it it's fun
